Description: There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
James Milner (Manchester City) is booked by the referee.

2 - 3
Goal! Alejandro Pozuelo tees up Wilfried Bony (Swansea) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:3.
52:48 – the latest ball possession ratio.
Substitution. Jack Rodwell (Manchester City) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jesus Navas walks off.
Manchester City enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
Pablo Zabaleta (Manchester City) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Phil Dowd ignores the protests.
Wayne Routledge (Swansea) bursts into the box, and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Roland Lamah (Swansea) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
That's the end of the game for Jonjo Shelvey, who is replaced by Alejandro Pozuelo (Swansea).
Edin Dzeko (Manchester City) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
Yaya Toure (Manchester City) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
The effort by Ben Davies (Swansea) failed to trouble the goalkeeper. He smashed the ball in from 30 metres but it went into the stands.
Yaya Toure (Manchester City) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
Jose Canas (Swansea) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Phil Dowd blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City are awarded a free kick.
This shall not pass! Edin Dzeko (Manchester City) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
Fernandinho (Manchester City) showed his incredible technique skills and delivered the ball to the free area where James Milner (Manchester City) latched on to his pass.
James Milner (Manchester City) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
Ashley Williams (Swansea) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
Corner kick. Swansea will have an opportunity.

Wilfried Bony (Swansea) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went straight towards the roof of the net, but Joe Hart made an astonishing save!
Jonathan de Guzman (Swansea) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
Benjamin Davies (Swansea) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area. The opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Swansea have been awarded a corner kick.
Here's the change. Samir Nasri leaves the pitch and James Milner (Manchester City) comes on as a substitute.
Angel Rangel (Swansea) produces a quality pass into the box, the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

1 - 3
Goal! Aleksandar Kolarov (Manchester City) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a shot from the edge of the box into the middle of the net, leaving Gerhard Tremmel beaten. The score is 1:3.
Swansea are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Wayne Routledge (Swansea), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
Fernandinho (Manchester City) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post. It's a goal kick.
Ashley Williams (Swansea) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
The corner from Jonathan de Guzman (Swansea) is cleared away by the defence.
The corner from Jonathan de Guzman (Swansea) is hurriedly cleared. Swansea have been awarded a corner kick.
The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Javi Garcia (Manchester City) will replace Alvaro Negredo.

1 - 2
Goal! Yaya Toure (Manchester City) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Pablo Zabaleta, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
Alvaro Negredo (Manchester City) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
Samir Nasri (Manchester City) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

Pablo Zabaleta (Manchester City) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play, and the assistant referee points at the corner flag. Manchester City will take it.
Jonathan de Guzman (Swansea) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
Fernandinho (Manchester City) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Swansea.
Swansea take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
What was Vincent Kompany (Manchester City) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
Aleksandar Kolarov (Manchester City) sends a killer pass from the edge of the box. One of the defenders reacts at the last minute and thwarts his effort.
Alvaro Negredo (Manchester City) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
Alvaro Negredo (Manchester City) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Gerhard Tremmel, who makes a comfortable save.
Jonathan de Guzman (Swansea) is flagged for offside.
The Swansea players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
Matija Nastasic (Manchester City) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Swansea try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.

What a poor attempt! Aleksandar Kolarov (Manchester City) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
Manchester City hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player. Their movement didn't last so long as they lost the ball. The ball is out of bounds. Swansea will have a throw-in.
The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Jonjo Shelvey (Swansea) gets booked.

1 - 1
Goal – 1:1! Jonathan de Guzman sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Wilfried Bony (Swansea) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the bottom right corner.
Wayne Routledge (Swansea) serves in a nice cross, but the defence clear the danger.
Samir Nasri (Manchester City) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Wilfried Bony (Swansea), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
The linesman raises his flag. Angel Rangel (Swansea) is adjudged offside.
Edin Dzeko (Manchester City) can't control an accurate defence-splitting pass very well, and thus one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
Jonathan de Guzman (Swansea) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

Wayne Routledge (Swansea) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball has crossed the goal line. Swansea are awarded a corner kick.
Excellent touch by Pablo Zabaleta (Manchester City)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
The booking goes to Edin Dzeko (Manchester City).
Jose Canas (Swansea) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
Ashley Williams (Swansea) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
Wayne Routledge (Swansea) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
Wayne Routledge (Swansea) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes out-of-play. Swansea are awarded a corner kick.
Jonathan de Guzman (Swansea) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

Wayne Routledge (Swansea) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area. The opposition's defence is alert, and one of the defenders clears the ball away. The ball went out of play. Swansea will have a chance to score from a corner.
The opposition's defence is alert as they clear out a dangerous cross, sent by Wayne Routledge (Swansea).
Fernandinho (Manchester City) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
Samir Nasri (Manchester City) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
Jose Manuel Flores Moreno (Swansea) trips an opposition player and Phil Dowd signals a foul. A free kick is awarded to Manchester City.

Edin Dzeko (Manchester City) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post! The ball crosses the byline and it's going to be a goal kick.
Samir Nasri (Manchester City) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

Jesus Navas (Manchester City) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The assistant referee points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
Samir Nasri (Manchester City) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

Edin Dzeko (Manchester City) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

Jose Canas (Swansea) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post.
Jonathan de Guzman (Swansea) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
Samir Nasri (Manchester City) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.

Jonathan de Guzman (Swansea) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Joe Hart was alert and the score remained the same.
Jonjo Shelvey (Swansea) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.
Jesus Navas (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
Samir Nasri (Manchester City) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

Edin Dzeko (Manchester City) wasted a good opportunity as he sends an inaccurate final pass into the box, which is blocked by the opponent's defence. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
Fernandinho (Manchester City) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post. It will be a goal kick.
The ball is whipped in from the corner by Samir Nasri (Manchester City), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

Pablo Zabaleta (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates. The opposing defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of bounds. Manchester City win a corner kick.
Wilfried Bony (Swansea) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

Aleksandar Kolarov (Manchester City) sends a sweet pass into the box towards Alvaro Negredo (Manchester City). He attempts to trick one of the opposing defenders, but fails as the ball is cleared out of the danger.
Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Jonathan de Guzman (Swansea). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

A promising cross into the box is nearly received by lurking Angel Rangel (Swansea). One of the defending players cuts out the effort to avert the threat. The ball leaves the pitch. Swansea have been awarded a corner kick.

0 - 1
The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Fernandinho (Manchester City) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Gerhard Tremmel. 0:1.
Samir Nasri (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

Pablo Zabaleta (Manchester City) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the opposition's defenders makes a quick reaction and spanks it away. The main referee points to the corner flag, Manchester City will take a corner.
Jesus Navas (Manchester City) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Gerhard Tremmel easily deals with the threat.
Edin Dzeko (Manchester City) receives a sweet pass inside the box from Pablo Zabaleta (Manchester City), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
Some great controlled play and passing from Manchester City. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Pablo Hernandez leaves the pitch to be replaced by Roland Lamah (Swansea).
Pablo Hernandez (Swansea) picks up an injury.
Manchester City possess the ball and make numerous short passes, but here comes an error and they lose possession. The ball is behind the sideline and Swansea will take a throw-in.
Wilfried Bony (Swansea) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the left post. Aim better, sir.
Manchester City keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
Edin Dzeko (Manchester City) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.

Yaya Toure (Manchester City) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Swansea continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.

Jonjo Shelvey (Swansea) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.

The first half has started.
Phil Dowd was nominated as the referee for this game.
